label: TMC5160 Stepper Demo
info: A positioning stage driven by the TMC5160 ramp generator. One Inject node sends {enable: true, current: 1.5, speed: 300, acceleration: 800} once at start. A second Inject node ticks every 5 s into a Function node that alternates {move_to: 400} and {move_to: 0}, so the chip moves forward and back by itself. A third Inject node polls the driver status every 2 s (any other message); a Function node checks msg.payload.fault and raises a Node-RED warning when it is non-zero and a notice when sg_result drops below 100, while a Debug node shows every reply.
